text:
The summary is largely accurate. The starting rent, 1 March review date, CPI floor and cap of 3% to 5% for years 2 to 4, the year 4 floor under the year 5 market review, the 30-day dispute window with equally split costs, outgoings being separate, and the 14-day notice rule all match the source. The one small embellishment is "landlord-appointed valuer." The guide says only that the landlord gets a valuer, so this is a reasonable inference but not stated. The main problem is the length constraint. Counting the bullets and the closing line, the response runs to roughly 135 words, which exceeds the 120-word limit. It also keeps the key points a manager needs, so the shortfall is in concision rather than content.

Score: 6
